|errata_history={{Card errata/Bespin (V)}}
This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Bespin (V)]] (version 2 of 2). It is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[Bespin (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Light Side: You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. Game text of opponent’s Admiral’s Orders is canceled. Dark Side: If you occupy and Dark Deal on table, flip This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time. Immune to Revolution.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
*: This card image with the picture area left blank was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024, under the label “•Bespin (DARK)”. Same words ([[:File:V23-D-bespin-2024-08-02-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip is part of this version, not a version of its own.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the errata card image (7 December 2025, for the PC's Set 26 errata and art updates)<ref name="ht-462fb5e">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/462fb5e5bf3d0fa5a0a3f4a9bff595708ec5dfce/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/462fb5e5bf3d0fa5a0a3f4a9bff595708ec5dfce 462fb5e] “Set 26 Errata and Art Updates”, 7 December 2025, for the PC's Set 26 errata and art updates.</ref> prints: “Light Side: You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. May not be converted. Dark Side: Executor may not move from here unless Vader aboard. If your [Cloud City] objective on table, Executor deploys -8 here.”<ref name="cj-34e6c8a">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/34e6c8a swccg-card-json commit 34e6c8a] “Set 26 Errata” (5 December 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' Dark Side: “If you occupy and Dark Deal on table, flip This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time. Immune to Revolution.” was replaced by “Executor may not move from here unless Vader aboard. If your [Cloud City] objective on table, Executor deploys -8 here.” Light Side: “Game text of opponent’s Admiral’s Orders is canceled.” was replaced by “May not be converted.” The picture of Bespin was also replaced with new artwork. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
*: This card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 26 December 2025, under the label “•Bespin (DARK)”. Same words ([[:File:V23-D-bespin-2025-12-26-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip is part of this version, not a version of its own.
